definitions.explanation: An imposing, authoritative presence that commands respect. A quality of noble bearing or solemn grandeur.

examples.japanese: {威厳|いげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{威厳|いげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}っている→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧{威厳|いげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That temple has a majesty born from its long history.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{威|い}→威：28463_i⟧ (authority, power) + {厳|げん} (strictness, solemnity)

USAGE:
Describes a quality that inspires awe and respect. Can describe people (leaders, elders, authority figures), places (temples, palaces), or abstract concepts (the law, traditions).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貫禄|かんろく}→貫禄：10570_kanroku⟧: gravitas from experience (more about personal weight/presence)
- ⟦{品格|ひんかく}→品格：09179_hinkaku⟧: refinement, class (more about elegance)
- ⟦{風格|ふうかく}→風格：09177_fuukaku⟧: stately bearing (more about style)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威厳|いげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: dignified, majestic
- {威厳|いげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain one's dignity
- {威厳|いげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose one's dignity
- {威厳|いげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: filled with dignity
